techniques: 快慢指针找左中点 fast = head.next
dummy 归并, 剩余整段接上

quiz.q: 快慢指针找中点并切开，怎么写？
quiz.idea: slow, fast = head, head.next；mid = slow.next，再断开 slow.next
wrong: slow, fast = head, head；mid = slow.next，再断开 slow.next
slow, fast = head, head.next；mid = slow，再断开 slow.next
slow, fast = head, head.next；mid = slow.next，不用断开

then.q: 合并时一条先走空了，怎么收尾？
then.idea: cur.next = left or right，剩下那段整体接上
wrong: cur.next = right，右半边一定是后走空的
不用处理，while 循环里已经全部接完
cur.next = right.next，跳过已比较过的节点
